Title: Do you shuffle after Coroner's Contact?

Messages.Author: Kraus
Messages.Body:
Hi!

It's usually a norm to shuffle any decks once you've searched something from there. Coroner's Contact however does not explicitly tell you to shuffle after finding a Samedi and placing him/her to the uncontroller region. Do we still shuffle, or does the Samedi player now know what vampires are there in which order?

References:

Coroner's Contact
Master.
Search your crypt to find a Samedi. Show it to all players and place it in your uncontrolled region with 1 blood from the bank.

Cheers!
